text: All the doctors are lovely and speak kindly, but some of the staff (perhaps assistants) could try to control their facial expressions and demeanor a bit. Everyone who comes for treatment is there to receive care and is ready to pay. Everyone has feelings and emotions. I don't know what you went through, but please remember that you work in the service industry. Try to put yourself in the customer's shoes. Everyone deserves good service commensurate with the money they pay. If anyone reading this recognizes themselves in this situation, please improve yourselves. *The clinic's image and the positive impression customers have of it are important, as is consideration. Please take note of this for the benefit of other customers.*
